plan.title: Anywhere docs: mark shipped features as shipped in anywhere.mdx and apply the settled pricing
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The Overdeck Anywhere release merged to main after v0.72.0, but anywhere.mdx (the 'Plans and pricing' page) still calls most of it planned: the top note, the 'What has shipped' table, and the 'One Overdeck server per machine', notifications and Fly roadmap steps. Its pricing reasoning predates OD-3 (relay and push costs 'not modeled', 'at launch only the vault exists', no reasons for the free directory or the relay cap). .pan/drafts/pan-2356.md lacks the supersede header W-DOC requires.
narratives.Proposal: Edit anywhere.mdx in four sequential slices (note and Plans; shipped table; roadmap steps; pricing reasoning) using the exact replacement text in .pan/drafts/pan-4775.md, plus one independent slice adding the supersede header to pan-2356.md. Shipped status was verified against git tags at planning time; every post-v0.72.0 feature says 'next release'. Unshipped items (hosted vault, billing, Shared Sessions, Hermes, hosted compute, PAN-4734, PAN-1676) stay labeled planned.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Fixing pre-existing mint broken-links findings in vision.mdx, cli/agent-commands.mdx or configuration/linked-machines.mdx (PAN-4779)
- Editing any docs page other than anywhere.mdx, including session-vault.mdx's stale 'v0.65.0' line and remote-access.mdx 'What comes next'
- Adding Anywhere entries to changelog.mdx's v0.73.0 Upcoming block
- Changing any price, tier or limit beyond OD-3 and the 2026-09-28 decision
- Adding supersede headers to pan-2352.md, pan-2355.md or pan-3513.md, or editing pan-2350.md
- Removing the accurate v0.64.0 and v0.65.0 table rows
- Renumbering accordions 1-9
- Writing a version number for features not in a release tag

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the v0.64.0 and v0.65.0 rows of the shipped table and add a v0.65.0 row for Continue on another device (PAN-4455)
autoDecisions.rationale: W-DOC calls them stale, but every row's PR is contained in tag v0.65.0 and listed in changelog.mdx under v0.65.0; deleting accurate history would make the table wrong.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the free account's 1 GB hosted vault on 2 machines, labeled planned, beside the directory's 3 machines
autoDecisions.rationale: OD-3 lists only the directory for the free account, but pan-2350.md says the 2026-09-28 decision (1 GB, 2 machines) is carried over unchanged, and accordions 2 and 8 depend on it; separate nouns avoid a contradiction.

autoDecisions.summary: Add the Hermes bridge (PAN-2353) as a 'Still planned' line in a new 'Webhook triggers and the MCP server' roadmap step
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says keep Hermes planned, but the page never mentions it; external-agent access belongs with triggers and MCP.

autoDecisions.summary: Retitle the Fly step 'Fly VMs as machines', mark it shipped via PAN-4652/PAN-4638, and list PAN-4734 and PAN-1676 as still planned
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4652 merged; PAN-1775 and PAN-1676 are still open, so linking them as shipped would be wrong; PAN-4734 replaces PAN-1775.

autoDecisions.summary: Drop the PAN-2352 (Cloudflare Tunnel) link from the notifications step and link PAN-1254 instead
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-2352 closed as superseded by Tailscale Serve, which is how remote access shipped.

autoDecisions.summary: Append the two new OD-3 reasoning accordions as 10 and 11 instead of renumbering
autoDecisions.rationale: Renumbering 1-9 churns the diff with no reader benefit.

autoDecisions.summary: pan-2356.md header copies the sibling first sentence and adapts the second ('Kept as the record of how PAN-2356 was built')
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the header, but pan-2356.md is already rebaselined, so the sibling text 'until rebaselined' would be false.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope the Mintlify link-check acceptance to anywhere.mdx and file PAN-4779 for the pre-existing failures
autoDecisions.rationale: mint broken-links exits 1 on main today because of vision.mdx and two parse errors in pages this issue does not own.
